heading: Notes from the desk.
letter:
Every issue starts the same way — a note on what's actually been interesting to look at, read, or think about this month, before it gets tidied into a formal article somewhere else.

This is the least polished page on the site on purpose. Trend radar, current obsessions, a reading list — the raw material, updated roughly monthly.
trend_radar: Quiet luxury giving way to more expressive, texture-forward maximalism in resort collections
Heritage handloom getting genuine (not just marketing-deep) attention from D2C fine jewelry brands
Fashion-week coverage shifting toward long-form video breakdowns over static street-style galleries
obsessions: Re-reading old Bocconi brand management case studies with fresh eyes
The Furla category page's keyword performance, still climbing
Capsule wardrobe thinking applied to content calendars, not just closets
reading_list: Business of Fashion's weekly trend briefings
A stack of old Tanishq and Manyavar campaign lookbooks, for research
closing_note: Back next month with the next one. If something here is worth arguing with, that's what the contact page is for.
